en.note: Shouted happily when excited or celebrating.

en.translate_as: Yes, I understand, no need to explain.
en.note: Said when quickly agreeing with excitement.

en.translate_as: That's final, no more discussion.
en.note: Said strongly to finish talk and show confidence.

en.translate_as: I'm very shocked or surprised.
en.note: Said after hearing shocking news or gossip.

en.translate_as: Good game, said at the end
en.note: Grandchild says this politely when an online game ends.

en.translate_as: A new or unskilled player
en.note: Children tease a beginner friend by calling him this.

en.translate_as: Too strong or too powerful
en.note: Used when a game character or weapon is too strong.

en.translate_as: To make something weaker
en.note: Game company reduces power of something too strong.

en.translate_as: To make something stronger
en.note: Opposite of nerf, game makes a weak thing strong.

en.translate_as: Doing same task many times to win
en.meaning_te: గెలవడానికి ఒకే పని మళ్ళీ మళ్ళీ చేయడం
en.note: Grandchild plays same level for hours to get points.

en.translate_as: One good player wins for the team
en.note: Said when one person does all the work in team game.

en.translate_as: To win at the last moment
en.note: Used when someone wins when almost losing.

en.translate_as: Player who hides in one place
en.note: Other players get angry at one who hides and shoots.

en.translate_as: Internet slow so game stops
en.note: Grandchild complains when video freezes due to net.

en.translate_as: Leave game angrily after losing
en.note: Someone loses, gets angry, and closes the game.

en.translate_as: Rude and mean player
en.note: Used for people who abuse others in game chat.

en.translate_as: Person playing too seriously
en.meaning_te: సరదా ఆటను చాలా సీరియస్ గా ఆడేవాడు
en.note: Friends joke when someone plays too seriously for fun game.

en.translate_as: Prizes or items collected in game
en.note: Treasure boxes or coins child collects in game.

en.translate_as: Come back alive in game
en.note: After dying in game, player starts again.

en.translate_as: Away, not playing for a while
en.note: Says this when going to eat or bathroom during game.

en.translate_as: Wow, amazing play
en.note: Viewers shout this when streamer does something cool.

en.translate_as: Join same game to trouble streamer
en.meaning_te: వీడియో చూసి అదే ఆటలోకి వెళ్లి ఇబ్బంది పెట్టడం
en.note: Fans watch live video and enter same game to meet star.

en.translate_as: Small mistake in game
en.note: When character gets stuck or wall disappears.

en.translate_as: A win, something good
en.note: Children type W in chat when streamer wins.

en.translate_as: greeting for Thanksgiving feast day in late November
en.meaning_te: నవంబర్ లో కుటుంబంతో విందు చేసే పండగ శుభాకాంక్షలు
en.note: Families gather to eat turkey together and say what they are thankful for.

en.translate_as: what kids say at doors on Halloween to ask for candy
en.meaning_te: హాలోవీన్ రోజు పిల్లలు ఇంటింటికి వెళ్లి చాక్లెట్లు అడిగే మాట
en.note: On Oct 31 kids wear costumes and neighbors give them candy.

en.translate_as: greeting for Oct 31 costume and candy day
en.note: Kids wear costumes like ghosts and collect candy at night.

en.translate_as: greeting for Dec 25 gift and Jesus birthday holiday
en.note: Families put a tree, give gifts, and Santa Claus brings toys for kids.

en.translate_as: greeting for Jan 1 start of new year
en.note: People count down at midnight and watch fireworks.

en.translate_as: greeting for America's birthday on July 4
en.note: People have BBQs and watch fireworks to celebrate America.

en.translate_as: greeting for spring church holiday with eggs and bunny
en.meaning_te: గుడ్లు, కుందేలు బొమ్మలతో వచ్చే వసంత పండగ శుభాకాంక్షలు
en.note: Kids hunt colored eggs that the Easter Bunny hides.

en.translate_as: Feb 14 day to show love with cards and chocolates
en.note: Couples and school kids give cards, flowers, and chocolates.

en.translate_as: day in May to honor mothers
en.meaning_te: మే నెలలో అమ్మను గౌరవించే రోజు శుభాకాంక్షలు
en.note: Kids give mom cards and flowers on the second Sunday in May.

en.translate_as: day in June to honor fathers
en.meaning_te: జూన్ నెలలో నాన్నను గౌరవించే రోజు శుభాకాంక్షలు
en.note: Kids give dad cards and gifts on the third Sunday in June.

en.translate_as: big discount shopping day after Thanksgiving
en.meaning_te: థాంక్స్ గివింగ్ తర్వాత చౌక ధరలకు కొనే రోజు
en.note: Stores open very early with big sales for Christmas shopping.

en.translate_as: last weekend in May to remember soldiers, start of summer
en.meaning_te: మే చివరలో సైనికులను తలచుకునే, వేసవి మొదలయ్యే సెలవు
en.note: Families have BBQs and visit graves of soldiers.

en.translate_as: first weekend in Sept, end of summer holiday
en.note: Families have one last BBQ and kids go back to school after.

en.translate_as: one week school holiday in March or April
en.meaning_te: మార్చి లేదా ఏప్రిల్ లో పిల్లలకు ఒక వారం స్కూల్ సెలవు
en.note: College kids often travel to the beach during this week.

en.translate_as: April 1 day for funny jokes and tricks
en.note: On April 1 people play small pranks and then say April Fools!

en.translate_as: Big exam to get into college
en.note: Students study a lot because good score helps college admission.

en.translate_as: Student in second year of high school
en.note: Usually 15 or 16 years old.

en.translate_as: Fourth and last year of high school
en.note: It is a special year with graduation and college applications.

en.translate_as: Main school sports team
en.note: It is a proud thing to be picked for varsity.

en.translate_as: Girl who dances and cheers at games
en.meaning_te: ఆటల్లో అరుస్తూ డ్యాన్స్ చేసి ప్రోత్సహించే అమ్మాయి
en.note: They wear uniform and lead the crowd to shout.

en.translate_as: Photo book given at end of school year
en.note: Friends sign it and write wishes to each other.

en.translate_as: Special fun way to invite someone to prom
en.meaning_te: ప్రామ్ కి రమ్మని అడగడానికి చేసే ప్రత్యేక ఆహ్వానం
en.note: Kids often use posters, flowers, or surprises to ask.

en.translate_as: Girl chosen by students at homecoming
en.note: It is like a popularity contest and she wears a crown.

en.translate_as: Hard college-level lessons in school
en.note: Good marks in these help for good colleges.

en.translate_as: Sports, clubs, and work outside study
en.meaning_te: చదువు కాకుండా చేసే ఆటలు క్లబ్ పనులు
en.note: Colleges like students who do these activities.

en.translate_as: School meeting to cheer before a game
en.meaning_te: ఆటకు ముందు విద్యార్థులు చేసే ఉత్సాహ వేడుక
en.note: All students gather in gym to shout and celebrate.

en.translate_as: first year of college
en.note: Grandchild may talk about being new and adjusting to college.

en.translate_as: shared bedroom students live in at college
en.note: Most students live with other students on campus.

en.translate_as: last big exams of the term
en.note: Students are very busy and stressed that week.

en.translate_as: social club for college boys
en.note: They live together and have parties.

en.translate_as: social club for college girls
en.note: Like a frat but for girls.

en.translate_as: party outside before a football game
en.note: Families eat, drink, and wear college colors.

en.translate_as: group of famous top colleges
en.note: Like Harvard and Yale, very hard to get into.

en.translate_as: small two-year local college
en.note: Cheaper and close to home, then transfer.

en.translate_as: money borrowed to pay for college
en.note: Many students must repay this money after college.

en.translate_as: Pasta with melted cheese sauce
en.note: A favorite comfort food for American kids at home and school.

en.translate_as: Meat patty with cheese in a bun
en.meaning_te: మధ్యలో మాంసం ముక్క, జున్ను పెట్టిన బన్ రొట్టె
en.note: The most common fast food in America.

en.translate_as: Sausage in a long soft bun
en.note: People eat it at baseball games and barbecues.

en.translate_as: Chicken coated and fried in oil
en.note: Very popular in fast food shops in the South.

en.translate_as: Thin fried potato sticks
en.note: Almost always served as a side with burgers.

en.translate_as: Flat bread with cheese and tomato on top
en.meaning_te: పైన జున్ను, టమాటా పెట్టి కాల్చిన రొట్టె ముక్క
en.note: American kids often eat pizza at parties.

en.translate_as: Soft flat round cakes for breakfast
en.meaning_te: ఉదయం తినే మెత్తని తీయటి దోశ లాంటి రొట్టెలు
en.note: Eaten for breakfast with syrup on top.

en.translate_as: Sweet fried round cake with hole
en.note: People bring donuts to office and school in the morning.

en.translate_as: Round chewy bread for breakfast
en.note: Often eaten toasted with cream cheese.

en.translate_as: Sweet pie with apples inside
en.meaning_te: లోపల తీయటి యాపిల్ ముక్కలు ఉన్న పై
en.note: Called a symbol of traditional America.

en.translate_as: Meat cooked slowly over fire with sauce
en.meaning_te: నిప్పు మీద నెమ్మదిగా కాల్చిన మసాలా మాంసం
en.note: Families make BBQ outside in summer.

en.translate_as: Buy food from car window at shop
en.meaning_te: కారులోనే కూర్చొని కిటికీ దగ్గర తిండి కొనడం
en.note: People order fast food without getting out of the car.

en.translate_as: Small van selling cooked food on street
en.meaning_te: వీధిలో నిలబడి ఆహారం అమ్మే చిన్న బండి
en.note: Common in cities for quick cheap lunch.

en.translate_as: Party where everyone brings food
en.meaning_te: అందరూ ఒక్కో వంటకం తెచ్చి కలిసి తినే విందు
en.note: Common at schools and churches so all share.

en.translate_as: Packing leftover restaurant food to take home
en.note: In America it is normal to take leftover food home.

en.translate_as: final championship game of American football
en.note: Families watch it in February with snacks, ads, and a halftime singing show.

en.translate_as: big hit in baseball, a big success
en.note: Kids say it when something goes very well in school or work.

en.translate_as: main score in American football, six points
en.note: Scored by carrying the ball into the end zone.

en.translate_as: forceful basketball shot, a sure success
en.meaning_te: బాస్కెట్బాల్లో పైనుండి బలంగా వేయడం, పక్కా విజయం
en.note: Used for any easy and certain win.

en.translate_as: last desperate long try to win
en.meaning_te: చివరి నిమిషంలో గెలవడానికి చేసే పెద్ద ప్రయత్నం
en.note: Comes from football when the team is losing at the end.

en.translate_as: big college basketball tournament in March
en.note: Friends fill brackets to guess which team will win.

en.translate_as: final championship of baseball
en.note: Played every October between two best baseball teams.

en.translate_as: extra time added to break a tie
en.note: Kids also use it when any game or work goes longer.

en.translate_as: short break to rest and plan in a game
en.note: Parents also say it for a short rest when a child is upset.

en.translate_as: best player of a team or season
en.note: Used in school too for who did the best work.

en.translate_as: last-second shot just before time ends
en.meaning_te: సమయం అయిపోయే చివరి సెకనులో కొట్టిన గోల్
en.note: Everyone cheers loudly when it happens in basketball.

en.translate_as: music show in the middle break of a game
en.meaning_te: ఆట మధ్యలో విరామంలో జరిగే పాటల కార్యక్రమం
en.note: The Super Bowl halftime show is watched by many singers fans.

en.translate_as: picnic with food by cars before a game
en.meaning_te: మ్యాచ్ ముందు కార్ల దగ్గర తినడం, ఆనందించడం
en.note: Families eat and talk in the parking lot before football.

en.translate_as: special honor for the greatest players
en.meaning_te: చాలా గొప్ప ఆటగాళ్లకు ఇచ్చే పెద్ద గౌరవం
en.note: It is like a museum for the best players in each sport.

en.translate_as: to watch many episodes at once
en.note: Grandchildren often do this on Netflix on weekends.

en.translate_as: warning that the story will be revealed
en.note: People say this before telling what happens in a movie.

en.translate_as: exciting ending that makes you wait
en.note: TV serials stop at an exciting point to make you watch next week.

en.translate_as: surprise change in the story
en.note: Used when a movie story suddenly changes in a surprising way.

en.translate_as: last show of the season
en.note: Families talk about it because everyone watches it together.

en.translate_as: short video showing a coming movie
en.note: Kids watch trailers on YouTube before a movie comes out.

en.translate_as: old movie made again in new way
en.note: Hollywood often makes old stories again for new children.

en.translate_as: next part of a movie story
en.note: If a movie is a hit, they make part 2 as a sequel.

en.translate_as: seen by many people very fast
en.note: A funny video becomes famous in one day if it goes viral.

en.translate_as: old photo or memory shared again
en.note: On Thursdays people post old childhood photos online.

en.translate_as: covering face when someone does silly thing
en.note: Used for a funny silly mistake in movies or real life.

forms: May the Force be with you
en.translate_as: wish good luck, from Star Wars movie
en.meaning_te: దేవుడు నీకు తోడుగా ఉండాలి అనే దీవెన
en.note: Famous blessing from the Star Wars movies every American child knows.

en.translate_as: Monday after Thanksgiving for online shopping discounts
en.meaning_te: థాంక్స్ గివింగ్ తర్వాత సోమవారం ఆన్లైన్లో తగ్గింపు అమ్మకాలు
en.note: It is the online version of Black Friday.

en.translate_as: very cheap special item to attract shoppers
en.meaning_te: జనాలను రప్పించడానికి చాలా చౌకగా అమ్మే వస్తువు
en.note: Only a few are available, so people rush to get them.

en.translate_as: Saturday to support small local shops
en.meaning_te: చిన్న స్థానిక కొట్లలో కొనమని చెప్పే శనివారం
en.note: It comes between Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

en.translate_as: looking at shops without buying
en.note: Grandkids say this when they go to the mall for fun.

en.translate_as: available for a lower price now
en.note: You will hear this a lot during holiday shopping.

en.translate_as: final very cheap sale to finish stock
en.meaning_te: మిగిలిన సరుకు అయిపోవడానికి చాలా చౌకగా అమ్మడం
en.note: Clearance items are usually in a special corner of the store.

en.translate_as: pay for one, get second one free
en.note: Stores use short form BOGO, said as boh-goh.

en.translate_as: ticket or code for extra discount
en.meaning_te: తగ్గింపు కోసం వాడే కూపన్ లేదా కోడ్
en.note: Americans often show coupons on phone at checkout.

en.translate_as: queue to pay at the store
en.note: On Black Friday these lines become very long.

en.translate_as: nothing left to buy, stock finished
en.note: Popular toys and electronics sell out quickly on Black Friday.

en.translate_as: buying suddenly without planning
en.note: Kids often laugh about buying candy or toys like this.

en.translate_as: special bill to exchange gift without price
en.meaning_te: ధర లేకుండా బహుమతి మార్చుకోవడానికి ఇచ్చే రసీదు
en.note: Americans keep this so gifts can be returned easily.

en.translate_as: give item back to store for refund
en.meaning_te: నచ్చకపోతే కొట్టుకు తిరిగి ఇచ్చి డబ్బు వెనక్కి తీసుకోవడం
en.note: Most US stores allow returns for 30 to 90 days.

en.translate_as: special market with branded goods at low price
en.meaning_te: పెద్ద బ్రాండ్ బట్టలు తక్కువ ధరకు దొరికే మాల్
en.note: Families often drive there for holiday shopping trips.

en.translate_as: busy bright lights area in New York City
en.meaning_te: న్యూయార్క్ నగరంలో లైట్లతో ఉండే రద్దీ ప్రదేశం
en.note: Kids go there for photos, shops, and New Year celebration.

en.translate_as: famous statue in New York as symbol of freedom
en.meaning_te: న్యూయార్క్ లో స్వాతంత్ర్యానికి గుర్తుగా ఉన్న పెద్ద విగ్రహం
en.note: Grandchild learns about it in school as a symbol of America.

en.translate_as: very big and deep natural valley in Arizona
en.meaning_te: అరిజోనాలో ఉన్న చాలా పెద్ద లోతైన లోయ
en.note: Families visit there for vacation and nature views.

en.translate_as: movie industry area in Los Angeles
en.meaning_te: లాస్ ఏంజెలెస్ లో సినిమాలకు ప్రసిద్ధమైన ప్రదేశం
en.note: Grandchild means movies and film stars when they say this.

en.translate_as: city in desert famous for lights, shows and hotels
en.meaning_te: వెలుగులు, ఆటలు, పెద్ద హోటళ్లకు ప్రసిద్ధమైన ఎడారి నగరం
en.note: Adults go there for shows and fun trips.

en.translate_as: famous cartoon theme park in California
en.meaning_te: కాలిఫోర్నియాలో ఉన్న డిస్నీ బొమ్మల పెద్ద ఆట పార్కు
en.note: Small children love to meet Mickey Mouse there.

en.translate_as: big Disney theme park in Florida
en.meaning_te: ఫ్లోరిడాలో ఉన్న పెద్ద డిస్నీ ఆట పార్కు
en.note: Many families take a special holiday trip there.

en.translate_as: very large famous waterfalls on US-Canada border
en.meaning_te: అమెరికా కెనడా సరిహద్దులో ఉన్న పెద్ద జలపాతం
en.note: Grandchild may show photos of water falling with loud sound.

en.translate_as: big public park in the middle of New York City
en.meaning_te: న్యూయార్క్ నగరం మధ్యలో ఉన్న పెద్ద పార్కు
en.note: Kids go there to play, walk, and picnic.

en.translate_as: house in Washington where the US President lives
en.meaning_te: అమెరికా అధ్యక్షుడు ఉండే వాషింగ్టన్ లోని తెల్ల ఇల్లు
en.note: Children learn about it when they study the President.

en.translate_as: famous red bridge in San Francisco
en.meaning_te: శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కోలో ఉన్న ప్రసిద్ధ ఎర్ర వంతెన
en.note: Grandchild may show its picture from a California trip.

en.translate_as: mountain with faces of four presidents carved on it
en.note: Kids see it in history books as an American symbol.

en.translate_as: first big nature park with geysers and animals
en.meaning_te: నీళ్లు చిమ్మే బుగ్గలు, జంతువులు ఉన్న పెద్ద ప్రకృతి పార్కు
en.note: Families go camping there to see bears and hot springs.

en.translate_as: very tall famous building in New York City
en.meaning_te: న్యూయార్క్ లో ఉన్న చాలా ఎత్తైన ప్రసిద్ధ భవనం
en.note: Visitors go to the top to see the whole city.

en.translate_as: famous street in New York for plays and musicals
en.note: Grandchild may talk about watching a singing play there.

en.translate_as: Big family meal in November with turkey
en.meaning_te: నవంబర్ లో కుటుంబం అంతా కలిసి టర్కీ భోజనం చేయడం
en.note: Most important American family holiday where children travel home to eat together.

en.translate_as: Party before a baby is born to give gifts
en.meaning_te: బిడ్డ పుట్టక ముందు బహుమతులు ఇచ్చే వేడుక
en.note: Usually only women friends and family gather to celebrate the mother-to-be.

en.translate_as: Party to announce if baby is boy or girl
en.meaning_te: పుట్టబోయే బిడ్డ అబ్బాయో అమ్మాయో చెప్పే వేడుక
en.note: A new custom where parents cut a cake with pink or blue inside.

en.translate_as: Parent who controls children too much
en.note: Used jokingly when parents worry and follow kids everywhere.

en.translate_as: Busy mom who drives kids to sports and school
en.meaning_te: పిల్లలను ఆటలకు, బడికి కారులో తిప్పే తల్లి
en.note: Describes suburban American family life centered on kids activities.

en.translate_as: Parents living alone after kids move out
en.meaning_te: పిల్లలు ఇల్లు వదిలి వెళ్లాక ఒంటరిగా ఉండే తల్లిదండ్రులు
en.note: In America kids usually leave home at 18 for college or job.

en.translate_as: Kids spending night at a friend's house
en.note: Very common for birthdays and weekends among American kids.

en.translate_as: Kids go door to door for candy on Halloween
en.meaning_te: హాలోవీన్ రోజు పిల్లలు ఇంటింటికి వెళ్లి చాక్లెట్లు అడగడం
en.note: On October 31 kids wear costumes and parents walk with them.

en.translate_as: Big gathering of extended family
en.meaning_te: దూరపు బంధువులు అందరూ కలిసే పెద్ద కలయిక
en.note: Often held in summer in a park with food and games.

en.translate_as: Fancy school dance for teenagers
en.meaning_te: స్కూల్ చివరి సంవత్సరంలో జరిగే పెద్ద డ్యాన్స్ పార్టీ
en.note: Parents take photos and kids dress up like a wedding.

en.translate_as: Family cooks meat outside on grill
en.meaning_te: ఇంటి వెనక పెరట్లో కాల్చిన మాంసం తినడం
en.note: Typical Sunday or 4th of July family get-together.

en.translate_as: Family plays indoor games together at home
en.meaning_te: కుటుంబం అంతా కలిసి ఇంట్లో ఆటలు ఆడడం
en.note: Parents do this to spend good time without phones.

en.translate_as: Kids search for hidden chocolate eggs
en.note: Families play this in spring around Easter festival.

en.translate_as: Small Christmas gifts in socks
en.meaning_te: క్రిస్మస్ కు గుడ్డ సాక్స్ లో పెట్టే చిన్న బహుమతులు
en.note: On Christmas morning kids open these small gifts first.

en.translate_as: Adult kids visit parents in December
en.meaning_te: డిసెంబర్ పండగకు పిల్లలు తల్లిదండ్రుల ఇంటికి రావడం
en.note: Expected custom that grown children travel home for Christmas.

en.translate_as: A regular daytime office job
en.meaning_te: పొద్దున నుండి సాయంత్రం వరకు చేసే మామూలు ఆఫీసు ఉద్యోగం
en.note: People say this when talking about normal office life.

en.translate_as: A job with full hours, about 40 hours a week
en.meaning_te: వారానికి నలభై గంటలు చేసే పూర్తి ఉద్యోగం
en.note: This usually comes with fixed salary and benefits like health insurance.

en.translate_as: A job with only few hours a week
en.meaning_te: వారానికి కొన్ని గంటలు మాత్రమే చేసే ఉద్యోగం
en.note: Many students do this while studying in college.

en.translate_as: Short training job for students to learn work
en.meaning_te: విద్యార్థులు పని నేర్చుకోవడానికి కొన్ని నెలలు చేసే తాత్కాలిక పని
en.note: College students in the US often do this before getting a real job.

en.translate_as: A short paper about your study and work
en.meaning_te: చదువు, పని వివరాలు రాసిన ఒక్క పేజీ కాగితం
en.note: You must give this paper to apply for any job in the US.

en.translate_as: A meeting to ask questions before giving a job
en.meaning_te: ఉద్యోగం ఇచ్చే ముందు అడిగే ప్రశ్నలు, మాట్లాడే సమావేశం
en.note: Grandchild may say they are nervous before this meeting.

en.translate_as: Meeting people to help find a job
en.meaning_te: ఉద్యోగం కోసం కొత్త వాళ్లతో పరిచయాలు పెంచుకోవడం
en.note: In the US, knowing people is very important to get jobs.

en.translate_as: The lowest pay allowed by law per hour
en.meaning_te: గంటకు ఇవ్వాల్సిన అతి తక్కువ కూలీ డబ్బులు
en.note: Many first jobs for young people pay this low amount.

en.translate_as: The salary money you get for your work
en.meaning_te: పనికి ప్రతి నెల లేదా వారం వచ్చే జీతం డబ్బులు
en.note: People are happy when they talk about their first paycheck.

en.translate_as: Doing office work from house on computer
en.meaning_te: ఆఫీసుకు వెళ్లకుండా ఇంటి నుండే కంప్యూటర్‌లో పని చేయడం
en.note: After COVID, many US jobs are done from home.

en.translate_as: The head person who gives you work
en.note: Grandchild will often talk about what their boss said.

en.translate_as: People who work with you in same place
en.note: This means office friends, not boss.

en.translate_as: Lose job because company has no money or work
en.meaning_te: కంపెనీలో పని తగ్గి ఉద్యోగం పోవడం, తప్పు చేయకపోయినా
en.note: This is different from a mistake, the company removes many people.

en.translate_as: Extra small work for extra money besides main job
en.meaning_te: ముఖ్యమైన ఉద్యోగంతో పాటు డబ్బు కోసం చేసే చిన్న అదనపు పని
en.note: Many young Americans do this to earn more money.

en.translate_as: Very famous American female singer
en.meaning_te: అమెరికాలో చాలా ఫేమస్ అయిన సింగర్ అమ్మాయి
en.note: Grandchildren often talk about her songs and concert tours.

en.translate_as: Very famous singer and performer
en.note: She is called Queen Bey by her fans for her powerful shows.

en.translate_as: Fans of Taylor Swift
en.note: Kids proudly call themselves Swifties if they love her songs.

en.translate_as: To be a crazy big fan
en.note: Teens say I stan BTS to mean they love that group very much.

en.translate_as: To become famous on internet quickly
en.note: A song goes viral when millions share it on TikTok and Instagram.

en.translate_as: Song popular because of TikTok videos
en.meaning_te: టిక్ టాక్ వీడియోల వల్ల ఫేమస్ అయిన పాట
en.note: Many new songs become hits because children make dances for them.

en.translate_as: Big music concert in California desert
en.note: Famous singers perform there and young people wear special clothes.

en.translate_as: Big prize show for singers
en.note: It is like the Oscars but for music, shown on TV every year.

en.translate_as: Famous singing show in football final
en.meaning_te: ఫుట్బాల్ ఫైనల్ మధ్యలో జరిగే పెద్ద పాటల షో
en.note: Stars like Rihanna and Usher sing while millions watch.

en.translate_as: Popular music groups from Korea
en.meaning_te: కొరియా దేశం నుండి వచ్చిన ఫేమస్ సంగీత గ్రూపులు
en.note: Groups like BTS and Blackpink are loved by US kids too.

en.translate_as: Famous male rap singer
en.meaning_te: చాలా ఫేమస్ అయిన రాప్ సింగర్ అబ్బాయి
en.note: Teens often quote his songs about love and life.

en.translate_as: Famous singer and businesswoman
en.note: She sings pop songs and also sells makeup called Fenty.

en.translate_as: Famous TV and fashion family
en.note: Kim Kardashian and her sisters are always in news and makeup ads.

en.translate_as: Singing group of young boys
en.note: One Direction and BTS are examples grandchildren may like.

en.translate_as: long fun drive to another place
en.note: American kids often take road trips with friends in summer.

en.translate_as: ask for front seat next to driver
en.note: Kids shout shotgun to get the front seat first.

en.translate_as: passenger who tells driver what to do
en.meaning_te: వెనక కూర్చుని డ్రైవర్ కు ఆర్డర్లు వేసేవారు
en.note: People joke about grandmas being backseat drivers.

en.translate_as: very angry driving and shouting
en.note: In heavy traffic some drivers get road rage.

en.translate_as: time when office traffic is very heavy
en.meaning_te: ఆఫీసు వేళలో చాలా ట్రాఫిక్ ఉండే సమయం
en.note: In US cities rush hour is around 8am and 5pm.

en.translate_as: cars stopped and cannot move
en.note: Grandchild may be late to a call because of a traffic jam.

en.translate_as: small car accident with little damage
en.meaning_te: చిన్న కారు గుద్దుకోవడం, పెద్ద దెబ్బ లేకపోవడం
en.note: People say fender bender when no one is hurt.

en.translate_as: drive for fun without permission
en.meaning_te: అనుమతి లేకుండా సరదా కోసం కారు తిప్పడం
en.note: Teens sometimes take parents car for a joyride.

en.translate_as: share one car with others
en.note: Moms carpool to take many kids to school.

en.translate_as: short stop for gas or bathroom on trip
en.meaning_te: ప్రయాణంలో పెట్రోల్ కోసం లేదా బాత్రూమ్ కోసం చిన్న ఆగడం
en.note: On long drives families make pit stops for snacks.

en.translate_as: office where you get driving license
en.note: Americans complain about long waiting lines at the DMV.

en.translate_as: card that lets you drive legally
en.note: US kids are excited to get a license at age 16.

en.translate_as: one US dollar
en.note: Kids say five bucks instead of five dollars when talking about price.

en.translate_as: send me money by phone app
en.meaning_te: ఫోన్ యాప్ తో నాకు డబ్బు పంపు
en.note: Young people in the US pay friends with the Venmo app instead of cash.

en.translate_as: each person pays their own share
en.note: Friends at a restaurant often split the bill instead of one person paying.

en.translate_as: each pays for themselves
en.note: People say this when dating or with friends so no one feels uncomfortable.

en.translate_as: give extra money to the server
en.note: In the US you must add 15 to 20 percent tip in restaurants.

forms: it costs an arm and a leg
cost an arm and a leg
en.translate_as: it is very expensive
en.note: People say this jokingly when something costs too much money.

en.translate_as: you can keep the extra money
en.note: People say this to drivers or servers as a small tip.

en.translate_as: will you pay with cash or bank card
en.note: Every shop in the US asks this when you go to pay.

en.translate_as: pocket money parents give kids weekly
en.meaning_te: తల్లిదండ్రులు పిల్లలకు ఇచ్చే వారపు ఖర్చు డబ్బు
en.note: American kids get allowance for small shopping or saving.

en.translate_as: small box where kids save coins
en.note: Little children keep coins in a pig-shaped box to learn saving.

en.translate_as: shop where everything is very cheap
en.note: Families go there to buy snacks and small things for one or two dollars.

en.translate_as: a place where kids stay and play in summer
en.note: Many US kids go there for one or two weeks in summer.

en.translate_as: a young adult who looks after kids at camp
en.meaning_te: క్యాంపులో పిల్లలను చూసుకునే అన్న లేదా అక్క
en.note: Counselors lead games and keep kids safe at camp.

en.translate_as: a small wooden house for sleeping
en.note: At camp, kids sleep together in cabins in the woods.

en.translate_as: a small fire outside for sitting around
en.meaning_te: చుట్టూ కూర్చోవడానికి బయట వేసే చిన్న మంట
en.note: Kids sing songs and tell stories around the campfire at night.

en.translate_as: a sweet snack with biscuit, chocolate and marshmallow
en.meaning_te: బిస్కెట్ చాక్లెట్ తెల్ల మిఠాయితో చేసే తీపి చిరుతిండి
en.note: Kids roast them over the campfire and eat them together.

en.translate_as: a thick warm bag for sleeping on the floor
en.note: Kids sleep in sleeping bags in tents and cabins.

en.translate_as: a cloth house for sleeping outside
en.meaning_te: బయట పడుకోవడానికి గుడ్డతో వేసే చిన్న గూడు
en.note: Families and campers set up tents when they stay outdoors.

en.translate_as: walking far in nature for fun
en.meaning_te: సరదా కోసం అడవిలో కొండల్లో దూరం నడవడం
en.note: Camp and road trip groups often hike on trails together.

en.translate_as: a small narrow boat moved with sticks
en.note: Kids at lake camps learn to paddle canoes on the water.

en.translate_as: liquid to keep insects away from skin
en.note: Everyone uses it at camp and on outdoor trips in summer.

en.translate_as: a place on the highway to rest and use toilet
en.note: Families stop there for bathroom and snacks on long drives.

en.translate_as: a shop where cars get petrol
en.note: On road trips families stop for fuel, food, and toilet.

en.translate_as: a big car with beds and kitchen inside
en.meaning_te: లోపల మంచం వంటగది ఉన్న పెద్ద కారు ఇల్లు
en.note: Some families travel and sleep inside an RV on trips.

en.translate_as: kids asking when the trip will end
en.meaning_te: ఇంకా ఎంతసేపు ఎప్పుడు చేరుతాం అని పిల్లలు అడగడం
en.note: Kids in the back seat say this again and again on long drives.
